poc_scope: Deploy Redwood private inference nodes inside Ardent Horizon VPC subnets using TF modules + Helm charts. Provide KMS integration (customer-managed AWS KMS key), configure immutable audit logs sent to customer S3 bucket with lifecycle + retention, validate SAML SSO + SCIM for console access. poc_acceptance_criteria: 1) TF + Helm apply reproducible in customer account with documented inputs. 2) KMS integration verified: keys used for model artifacts and disk encryption, KMS calls appear in CloudTrail + Redwood audit logs. 3) Audit logs stored in customer S3, retention policy applied (7 years), logs include request_id, model_version, user_id, timestamp. 4) Performance: P99 < 120ms (chat) under 60 req/s sustained for 48h soak. 5) Security sign-off from InfoSec and Compliance.
integration_test_plan:
- Pretest: security rules check, egress allowlist, IAM roles verified, KMS policy aligned.
- Deploy: run TF module, helm upgrade --install, post-deploy smoke test.
- Traffic: 48h soak, 100 concurrent users, average prompt 120 tokens, mix of chat/generate/embedding calls.
- Monitoring: capture per-token cost, latency histograms, KV cache hit rate, CPU/GPU utilization.
- Postmortem: produce test report, list of findings + remediation, update runbook.
